entries.description: Retired baton/checklist instructions in CLAUDE.md in favor of the Dabbler session-set workflow (docs/dabbler/start-here.md); README notes docs/batons and docs/checklists as pre-Dabbler historical record; Dabbler scaffold committed; .gitignore added (.venv, Office lock files).

Module 2 (cnb-staff-line.js) verified against architecture plan (shipped in pre-Dabbler Session 9 commit c9ea41e); no changes needed. Repaired corrupted cnb/test-pages/test-staff.html script block and added 3-6-9 + line-override visual case.

Module 3 (cnb-staff.js) verified against architecture plan (shipped in Session 9): getPositions/render/getMidpoint present; cnb-staff-tests.js covers 4-8 -> [4,8,16,20], 3-6-9 -> [3,6,9,15,18,21], overrides, pct thickness. Full suite 123/123, legacy 240/240.

Module 4 (cnb-ledger-line.js): fixed rounded-rect variant (was drawing hollow outline with stroke as thick as the rect, doubling visual thickness; now fills the rect body). Created cnb/test-pages/test-ledger.html visual test page with rounded/plain/dashed/dotted variants over the debug grid.

Routed gate REQUIRED (blast-radius, multi-module, breadth over 37-file diff). Cross-provider verification round 1 via route() -> gpt-5-4 (openai), $0.1283: ISSUES_FOUND (missing thickness-from-pct staff test; license bundling noted as disclosed Minor). Remediation commit bf50ccd added two pct-to-px conversion tests (125/125). Round 2 via gpt-5-4, $0.0295: VERIFIED, 0 issues. Raw reviews in s1-verification.md.

Audited Session-9 cnb-notehead.js against arch plan Module 6: API conforms (measure/render). Expanded cnb-notehead-tests.js from 2 to 6 tests (aspect ratio, linear scaling, synthetic shape). Reworked test-notehead.html to render solid/hollow noteheads at semitone positions against the debug grid overlay (previously fixed-pixel placement, no grid).

Audited Session-9 cnb-stem.js against arch plan Module 8: fixed defect where geometry() computed but ignored anchor.y, attaching stems at notehead center instead of the 4-point anchor (visible on hollow minims). Expanded cnb-stem-tests.js from 7 to 13 tests (crotchet-vs-minim anchor selection up/down, extension direction/magnitude, anchor-y attachment, missing anchor key). Created missing test-stem.html with anchor-point cross markers over the debug grid. All 134 cnb tests + 240 legacy tests pass; 32-check DOM-stub render smoke confirms stem ends sit exactly on selected anchors.
